memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Osteoporosis and stage 3b chronic kidney disease.
Patient denies bone pain or dyspnea. BP 138/86 mmHg, mild bilateral ankle edema, lungs clear. Never smoked; inhaler technique not applicable. Labs show elevated creatinine, reduced eGFR, mild albuminuria, low vitamin D and osteoporotic T‑score.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Alendronate 70 mg oral once weekly
Calcium carbonate 500 mg oral twice daily with vitamin D3 400 IU
Telmisartan 40 mg oral once daily
Dapagliflozin 10 mg oral once daily
Furosemide 20 mg oral once daily
Sodium bicarbonate 500 mg oral twice daily
Continue until review.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Serum creatinine 1.8 mg/dL (0.6-1.2); eGFR 38 mL/min/1.73m2 (>60); urine albumin‑creatinine ratio 45 mg/g (<30); hemoglobin 11.2 g/dL (13.0‑17.0); serum calcium 8.9 mg/dL (8.5‑10.5); serum 25‑OH vitamin D 18 ng/mL (30‑100); DEXA lumbar spine T‑score –2.8.

Ankle edema 2+ bilaterally, mild fatigue, BP 150/92, lungs clear. Never smoked; inhaler technique not applicable. Consider reducing sodium bicarbonate due to metabolic alkalosis risk.
